Nina P.: Customer cust-341 flagged a weird charge on their dedicated APAC bill INV-6219 — burst shows 9,200 tokens billed twice across two nodepools. Invoice: https://invoices.redwood/inv_6219.pdf :confused:
Jonah L.: Oof. Can you paste the line items? also which billing window?
Nina P.: Window 2026-05-01 -> 2026-05-31. Condensed export below: ```id,desc,nodepool,committed,used,burst,amount
D3001,Reserved commit - apac-main,apac-main,120000,118000,0,6000.00
D3002,Burst usage - apac-main,apac-main,120000,9200,9200,460.00
D3003,Burst usage - apac-standby,apac-standby,0,9200,9200,460.00
D3004,Reserved commit - apac-standby,apac-standby,40000,39000,0,2000.00
``` Looks like the 9.2k burst is on both apac-main and apac-standby for the same minute ranges.
Ravi S.: metering-bot shows a short maintenance window where traffic was mirrored to standby: 2026-05-14T02:45:00Z -> 2026-05-14T02:59:00Z. Metering event: me-9091. Logs: /meters/me-9091.log
metering-bot: Mirror event detected for cust-341. Mirror duration 14m. Source tag retained for 7m then cleared for remainder.
Nina P.: If tokens were mirrored, our billing pipeline may have recorded both as billable. Customer dispute raised. We should either (A) reclassify the standby burst line as non-billable mirror, or (B) credit the duplicated amount.
Jonah L.: Policy check: for internal mirror/maintenance that duplicates metering, billing credits full duplicated burst amount. Documentation requires evidence: (1) mirror/maintenance log, (2) token-level dedupe showing identical token ids across both streams, (3) customer mapping.
Olivia K.: Product would prefer we automatically tag mirrored traffic with a nonbillable flag at metering-proxy so it never reaches billing as burst. Filing INFRA-948 to add mirror_flag at capture time.
Ravi S.: I've kicked off a token hash export for the 2026-05-14 window. Export path: /exports/cust-341/20260514_token_hashes.csv. ETA 2h.
Nina P.: Created billing case BILL-2026-331 and put INV-6219 on review hold until 2026-06-05. Attached condensed CSV, mirror logs, and customer support transcript.
Kai (Accounting): Finance can approve provisional credit up to $600 for duplicated burst if token dedupe confirms duplication. JE to use 6-170-BILL and memo "mirror duplicated burst credit cust-341". Final approval after vendor reconciliation.
Jonah L.: Next steps: devops to confirm token dedupe; billing to request vendor to reclassify line D3003 as non-billable; finance prepare provisional JE. Target resolution 2026-06-04.
Nina P.: I'll update the customer with a provisional note: we've placed the invoice under review and may issue a credit pending verification. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
